scope: Live read-only provider model discovery through the managed xMind CLI profile

provider-models.purpose: Discover account models using the saved OpenAI profile credential

limitations: This verifies managed CLI profile discovery and saved-key reuse, not an interactive coding run through the CLI.
The `models` command lists backend-enabled execution models; it is distinct from account discovery through `provider-models`.
The tested xMind binary is a local validation runtime, not an installed release package.
